data.exact_reserve_text: Majority of this increase is attributed to the in year result which was largely driven by investment loss, offset partially by the recovery of the 2019 Year of Account ("YOA") loss from capital providers during the distribution process. The Syndicate recorded an underwriting profit before investment income of GBP 3.2m (2021: GBP 6.6m loss), mainly driven by an improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result. During 2022 we saw an increase of claims incurred due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years. This is current held primarily in IBNR.

improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result.

named_events.loss_description: increase of claims incurred due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years. This is current held primarily in IBNR.
Other losses for which the Syndicate had large exposure during the year were Hurricane Ian.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2022. There was a recovery of the 2019 Year of Account loss and an improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 Year of Account, contributing GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result. However, claims incurred increased due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years, primarily held in IBNR, and large losses from Hurricane Ian.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development is not explicitly stated. The claims development triangle is distorted by RITC impact of GBP 23.086m on gross claims provisions, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. Narrative mentions net releases for 2019 and 2021 underwriting years, and adverse development from the war in Ukraine affecting all underwriting years, but no gross quantified figure for total prior year development.
